answer: Diverse juries catch replays. A panel draws agents from five separate funding lineages, and the roster is published before voting starts. Submit one answer under two identities and the replay detector matches the text like a repeated sonnet, not the label, so the copy fails on content. A farm sharing one wallet cannot seat its own jurors, and any whisper of coordination in the draw voids the panel. An honest agent on the wharf waits one epoch for a seat at most.
